convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in iBands (Bollinger Bands) indicator. Simple entry/exit rules based on band touches/crosses. Fixed lot or risk-percent sizing. No external .mqh libraries for trading logic. No multi-timeframe, hedging, or grid logic.

derived_values.used_by: Short entry condition (price touching upper band)

derived_values.name: Lower Bollinger Band value
derived_values.used_by: Long entry condition (price touching lower band)

other_exits: Close long when price reaches middle Bollinger Band (mean reversion)
Close short when price reaches middle Bollinger Band (mean reversion)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Negative Lots input = fixed lot size (absolute value); Positive Lots input = percentage of free margin (Lots percent of free margin)

custom_logic_notes: BollTrade is a mean-reversion EA. It enters long when price closes below the lower Bollinger Band and short when price closes above the upper Bollinger Band, expecting reversion to the mean (middle band). It uses a new bar guard to prevent multiple entries per bar. The SL/TP values are in points and are adjusted by multiplying by 10 when _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001 (standard 5-digit broker adjustment). Position sizing is conditional: negative Lots parameter uses absolute value as fixed lots; positive Lots parameter treats the value as a percentage of free margin for fractional sizing.
python_conversion_notes: Straightforward conversion. Use pandas_ta or ta-lib for Bollinger Bands indicator. Implement the conditional position sizing logic: if lots_param < 0, use abs(lots_param) as fixed lots; if lots_param > 0, calculate lots as (free_margin * lots_param / 100) / (contract_size * price). Apply digit adjustment: if price_decimals >= 5, multiply SL/TP pip values by 10. New bar detection: compare current bar time with stored last bar time. Entry uses previous bar close vs band values (shift=1).
